resources.name: Sanctions Oracle Sync Script
resources.description: Documentation and examples for the sanctions-oracle sync script CLI

resources.name: [CLI] Dry-run against testnet
resources.description: Dry-run invocation that checks addresses without submitting transactions. Useful for testing the sync logic without network interaction.

body.text:
{
  "command": "npm run sanctions-sync",
  "args": [
    "node",
    "dist/sync.js",
    "--addresses",
    "./test/fixtures/addresses.json",
    "--dry-run"
  ],
  "description": "Runs the sanctions sync script in dry-run mode (no transactions submitted)",
  "expectedOutput": {
    "checked": 3,
    "flagged": ["GCDVWDVSFNX43HOAIMRLPHJAQMPRRDZGRUE6DM6IFSV35BBNMGEZ662M"],
    "written": [],
    "dryRun": true
  }
}

resources.name: [CLI] Live sync to testnet
resources.description: Live invocation that submits transactions to a Soroban contract. Requires valid network credentials.

body.text:
{
  "command": "npm run sanctions-sync",
  "args": [
    "node",
    "dist/sync.js",
    "--addresses",
    "./test/fixtures/addresses.json",
    "--contract-id",
    "CABCDEF...",
    "--rpc-url",
    "https://soroban-testnet.stellar.org",
    "--network-passphrase",
    "Test SDF Network ; September 2015",
    "--secret-key",
    "SABCDEF..."
  ],
  "description": "Runs the sanctions sync script in live mode (submits transactions)",
  "notes": "Requires:",
  "required_flags": [
    "--addresses (path to JSON array of addresses)",
    "--contract-id (deployed denylist-gate contract ID)",
    "--rpc-url (Soroban RPC endpoint)",
    "--network-passphrase (matching the RPC endpoint's network)",
    "--secret-key (funding account secret key, must have XLM balance)"
  ],
  "expectedOutput": {
    "checked": 3,
    "flagged": ["GCDVWDVSFNX43HOAIMRLPHJAQMPRRDZGRUE6DM6IFSV35BBNMGEZ662M"],
    "written": ["GCDVWDVSFNX43HOAIMRLPHJAQMPRRDZGRUE6DM6IFSV35BBNMGEZ662M"],
    "dryRun": false
  }
}

resources.name: [Schema] Expected addresses JSON file
resources.description: The JSON file format expected by the --addresses flag. Should be an array of valid Stellar addresses (public keys).

resources.description: Complete reference of all CLI flags accepted by the sync script.
